opportunities.title: Conference Attendance Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to members of The Physiological Society. Postgraduate, Full and Fellow member applicants must be submitting/presenting an abstract at the meeting they wish to attend. Value and frequency vary with membership category.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support member engagement at Society meetings and Society-sponsored events, covering registration, meeting dinners, and a contribution toward travel and accommodation.

opportunities.title: Education and Teaching Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to members of The Physiological Society; the applicant's host institution must be willing to administer the award.
opportunities.summary: Supports members wishing to develop new educational resources or conduct a piece of publishable educational research addressing a key question in physiological education.

opportunities.title: Research and Knowledge Exchange Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to members of The Physiological Society; the applicant's host institution must be willing to administer the award.
opportunities.summary: Supports members wishing to conduct pilot studies, develop a new technique or finalise a project, as well as activities to promote knowledge transfer and impact.

opportunities.title: Institutional Engagement Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Society Representatives and members; applications must be supported by a Society Representative or a Fellow.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to support Society Representatives and members to host events at their organisation, including internal conferences, teaching symposia, seminars or outreach events.

opportunities.title: Unlocking Futures Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to postdoctoral researchers who are members of The Physiological Society.
opportunities.summary: Provides additional support to postdoctoral researchers to help them achieve their full potential, e.g. for consumables, registration for Higher Education Academy Fellowship or other justified sundries.

opportunities.title: Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full members or Fellows of The Physiological Society in their second year of membership or longer.
opportunities.summary: Provides support for Members to run activities that address equity, diversity and inclusion principles in the physiological sciences, in either teaching or research.
